function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT sl.period, c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.channel,
       SUM(sl.qty) AS qty,
       SUM(sl.revenue_cad) AS revenue,
       SUM(sl.qty * p.wholesale_price_cad) AS wholesale_cost
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line sl
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.customer c ON sl.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.product p ON sl.sku = p.sku
WHERE sl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY sl.period, c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.channel
ORDER BY sl.period, qty DESC","purpose":"Qty, revenue, wholesale cost by customer for Aug and Sep 2026"}
